title: Excavations in Palestine in 1931-2: 'Isawiya
author: (round-up; tombs cleared by E. L. Sukenik)
location_note: Near 'Isawiya; the text gives the P.E.F. map square XVII M t only (not a coordinate); placed by name.
notes: Cleared July 1932. First cave: 23 ossuaries, mostly plain or rosette-decorated, with Greek and Hebrew/Aramaic names (MAPOAC, Simeon bar Ton, Grida, Matatyah); Hellenistic lamps and pottery in a niche. Second cave destroyed: one inscribed ossuary (Yehonatan), a jug. The report gives no period for the tombs other than 'Hellenistic' lamps.

features.subtype: two cave tombs with ossuary burials (23 ossuaries in the first), lamps in a niche
features.period: not stated; 'Hellenistic clay lamps' in a niche
features.quote: The first cave contained twenty-three ossuaries mostly of the ordinary type
